Consistently drops both 'Grand' and 'Mu', rendering just 'the Temple Depths' (mid-sentence) / 'Temple Depths' (standalone label) / 'Temple Depths Panel' (マス-suffixed panel label) - mirrors 大神殿入口 -> 'the Temple Entrance' and 大神殿内部 -> 'the Temple Interior', both of which show the identical explicit-Mu-vs-elliptical split. The note's stated reasoning does not hold up against the actual pattern, so it is not treated as a valid documented exception; realigned to 'Temple Depths Panel'.
